name: assembly-newsh2-53
summary: A red-and-brass machinery block set into grey rock (four ground pieces, 48x56 px): red elbow pipes and a red pump housing top left, two glowing orange canister lights, a stacked red box, a dark central housing with a recessed brown hatch and louvred vents framed by angular red trim, a brass box with a round red lens on the left, twin red panels, a red pipe bending down the right, a slanted brass panel and red blocks lower down, all ringed by boulders. Hard-surface machinery: flat bevelled plates and boxes stacked in height, round only where the sprite draws pipes, canisters and the lens.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: two glowing orange lights (cols 14-18, rows 12-14 and 18-20), emissive, yellow-white core
each a horizontal canister lying across the block (round, about as tall as it is wide, ~3 px)
set in a dark socket with metal end caps, not a flat yellow tile
features.note: The concept draws them as glowing hazard-striped canisters stacked one above the other.

traits: red pipe about 5 px across running down col 5 from row 2, bending right along rows 7-9 to col 16
constant diameter through the bend, round, standing about as tall as it is wide
sits above the red pump housing
features.note: Concept: red elbow pipes feeding the housing.

traits: red box cols 3-11 rows 10-16 with a lighter top, clearly raised above the floor (several px)
a smaller grey/red step to its right (cols 11-16) leading to the lights
flat top with chamfered edges
red box cols 22-27 rows 8-15, the tallest box of the top half
two stacked parts: a lid (rows 8-11) on a lower body with a dark seam between them
features.note: Concept: a stacked red box column beside the lights.

traits: dark metal housing (cols 19-34, rows 17-27, and down the right to row 33) raised above the black floor
angular red trim along its top edge (rows 16-17), down its right side (col 34) and along row 27
trim is flat-topped bars with crisp edges, not round pipes
features.note: Concept: dark housing framed by red trim.

traits: brown hatch cols 23-29 rows 21-26 cut into the housing (lower than the housing top)
grey louvre ribs beside it (cols 30-33, rows 22-26) and along row 19, set into the housing top
brown/brass box cols 0-10 rows 17-28 with a gold rim along its left and bottom edges
round red lens (cols 3-7, rows 20-25) bulging out of a dark socket, glossy
box raised a few px above the floor
features.note: Concept: brass box with a red glass lens.

traits: two red plates side by side (cols 11-14 and 15-18, rows 22-26) with a dark seam between
dark red vented skirt below them (rows 26-30) with slots cut in
raised like the lens box
features.note: Concept: two red panels with vents below.

traits: red pipe 3 px across turning down from row 33 along cols 29-31 to row 48
constant diameter, round, lit down its left side
a thinner dark red branch to col 34 and a bar across row 48
brown/brass panel cols 6-11 rows 33-47 with a gold diagonal rib
grey rail on its left edge (col 6, rows 36-41)
raised plate with chamfered edges
features.note: Concept: brass armour block with a chevron.

traits: dark red block cols 13-19 rows 39-47 with a lighter red raised top plate (rows 39-42)
chrome fittings at the top (grey/white pixels cols 6-12 and 28-32, rows 1-3)
gold pipe along row 4 between them
features.note: Concept: horizontal pipe with chrome couplings across the top.

traits: grey boulders ringing the block (shown: the right edge), faceted and matte
sand-coloured stones at the top and bottom edges
